# Baripas Studio

> Baripas Studio is an independent single-player mobile game studio based in Türkiye. Its flagship title is Cube Pattern, a free 3D cube memory game for iPhone, iPad and Android. The studio builds calm, focused games with no feeds and no chat.

Contact: contact@baripas.studio · Site: https://baripas.github.io/ · Last updated: 2026-11-06

## Cube Pattern

- [Cube Pattern (English)](https://baripas.github.io/cube-pattern.html): Free 3D cube memory game. Watch the glowing tile pattern on a rotating cube, rebuild it tile by tile. 100 levels, daily challenge, 4 modes, offline play, 6 languages. App Store id 6825930492; Google Play package com.barip.cubepattern.
- [Cube Pattern (Türkçe)](https://baripas.github.io/cube-pattern-tr.html): Ücretsiz 3D küp hafıza oyunu; 100 bölüm, günlük meydan okuma, çevrimdışı, altı dil.
- [Cube Pattern (Deutsch)](https://baripas.github.io/cube-pattern-de.html): Kostenloses 3D-Würfel-Gedächtnisspiel; 100 Level, Tages-Challenge, Offline, sechs Sprachen.
- [Cube Pattern (Español)](https://baripas.github.io/cube-pattern-es.html): Juego de memoria 3D gratuito; 100 niveles, reto diario, sin conexión, seis idiomas.
- [Cube Pattern (Français)](https://baripas.github.io/cube-pattern-fr.html): Jeu de mémoire 3D gratuit ; 100 niveaux, défi quotidien, hors ligne, six langues.
- [Cube Pattern (Português)](https://baripas.github.io/cube-pattern-pt.html): Jogo de memória 3D gratuito; 100 níveis, desafio diário, offline, seis idiomas.

## Key facts

- Genre: 3D spatial memory puzzle / casual brain game.
- Developer: Baripas Studio (Türkiye).
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad (iOS/iPadOS 16+), Android 8.0+.
- Price: free to download; optional premium (monthly, yearly, lifetime), starter pack, collections, hint packs and coin packs. Rewarded ads are optional.
- Content: 100 story levels in 10 chapters, three-round Master Cube finale, daily challenge (UTC), Memory Climb, 60s Blitz, Zen.
- Systems: boosters (Hint, Time Freeze, Replay, Shield), memory profile with 8 dimensions, achievements, weekly leaderboard, friends, ghost challenges, live events, cosmetics and mascots.
- Offline: story levels and modes work without internet; sign-in is optional and only needed for sync, leaderboard and social features.
- Accounts: guest play, optional Google sign-in, cloud sync, in-app account deletion and a web deletion page.
- Languages: English, Turkish, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese.
- Privacy: no feed, no chat; analytics and crash reporting are opt-in.
